title: National Housing Fund Act, Cap. N45, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria 2004
kind: Act (Laws of the Federation of Nigeria 2004 revision)

text_caveat: The reproduction renders subsection numbers inconsistently (e.g. s. 4 as "a)", "b)" where the LFN has (1), (2)) and runs several subsections together on one line in the subsidiary regulations; the numbering here follows the PDF, not the LFN. The PDF bears no gazette or Government Printer marks.
why_this_instrument: The 2.5% of basic monthly salary that a Nigerian worker earning N3,000 a year or more must contribute (s. 4), the employer deduction duty (s. 9), the refund on retirement (s. 17) and the tax exemption (s. 23); the contribution is an eligible deduction under s. 30 of the Nigeria Tax Act.
